pushBannerURL.description: Optional HTTPS dashboard URL echoed to every accepted git push as remote: watch output. Empty disables the line.

tsaURL.description: RFC 3161 timestamp authority HTTPS URL. Empty (the default) disables external timestamps; the local audit hash chain always runs. HTTPS is required unless tsaInsecureHTTP is enabled for development.

tsaInsecureHTTP.description: DEVELOPMENT ONLY: allow a plain-HTTP TSA URL.

rekorURL.description: Rekor transparency log URL. Empty (the default) disables external witness publication and startup witness recovery; the local audit hash chain always runs. HTTPS is required unless rekorInsecureHTTP is enabled for development.

rekorInsecureHTTP.description: DEVELOPMENT ONLY: allow a plain-HTTP Rekor URL.

rekorCA.description: Optional PEM bundle pinning the Rekor HTTPS TLS trust anchors (public material, delivered via ConfigMap).

rekorPublicKey.description: Optional PKIX PEM public key pinning the Rekor log identity instead of Sigstore TUF (public material, delivered via ConfigMap).

tsaCA.description: Optional PEM bundle pinning the TSA HTTPS TLS trust anchors (public material, delivered via ConfigMap).

sshPort.description: Service port for SSH. Under LoadBalancer this is the port svclb binds on the host, so it defaults to 2222 to avoid the host's own sshd; 22 is correct on a node dedicated to Oberth.

httpsPort.description: Service port for HTTPS/MCP. Under LoadBalancer this is the port svclb binds on the host.

sshNodePort.description: Node-wide SSH NodePort. Defaults to 30022, which is the documented client-facing port and what an adopted Service already holds; it is overridable only so a second instance (a canary) can coexist on one node without contending for it.

httpsNodePort.description: Node-wide HTTPS/MCP NodePort. Defaults to 30443, overridable for the same reason as sshNodePort.

extraDNSNames.description: Additional DNS names the generated server certificate is issued for, beyond the in-cluster ones. A client reaching the server on any other name hits a hostname mismatch, which no trust anchor can fix. Ignored when tls.existingSecret is set, and applied only when the certificate is generated.

extraIPs.description: Additional IP addresses the generated server certificate is issued for. An address reached as an IP needs an IP SAN; a DNS name will not match it.

name.description: Upstream name: DNS-1123 label (lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphen, max 53 chars). Must match app.ValidateUpstreamName.

networkPolicy.description: Egress isolation for the pipeline namespace. Default-deny with targeted allowlist for DNS, HTTPS (443/6443), and the secret store.

enabled.description: Create a NetworkPolicy in the pipeline namespace restricting egress. Disable on clusters without a NetworkPolicy-capable CNI.

vault.description: Secret store egress destination. In-cluster: set namespace (default openbao). External: set externalCIDRs. Port defaults to 8200, consistent with argo.vault.address.

namespace.description: Namespace where the secret store runs (used as a namespaceSelector label match). Default: openbao.

externalCIDRs.description: CIDRs for an external secret store (e.g. 10.0.1.5/32). When set, namespace is ignored and ipBlock rules are rendered instead.

inNamespacePorts.description: TCP ports on which pipeline pods may reach other pods in the same namespace (e.g. a Docker API shim for Testcontainers). Ignored when inNamespaceAllPorts is true.

inNamespaceAllPorts.description: Allow pipeline pods to reach any pod in the same namespace on any port. Broader than inNamespacePorts; intended for local development clusters.

argo.description: Argo Workflows execution engine. Every pipeline runs as an Argo Workflow.

namespace.description: Namespace pipelines run in. Must differ from the release namespace: Vault Kubernetes-auth roles bind (namespace, ServiceAccount) pairs.

pipelineServiceAccount.description: Identity for pipeline templates without approved secrets. No Vault role, no token.

credentialedServiceAccount.description: Identity for templates with approved secrets. Carries a projected token for OpenBao login.

executorServiceAccount.description: Identity for Argo's own executor containers. Must differ from all pipeline identities.

address.description: OpenBao API base URL injected into credentialed containers as VAULT_ADDR. HTTPS required.

credentialedRole.description: OpenBao Kubernetes auth role, bound to exactly the credentialed ServiceAccount and namespace.

caCert.description: PEM trust anchors credentialed containers verify the Vault address against, delivered into the run's source volume and advertised as VAULT_CACERT. Certificates only; the server refuses a bundle carrying a private key.

sourceStorageClass.description: Storage class for the per-run pipeline source volume. Empty selects the cluster default.

secretstore.description: Secret-store-sourced release secrets from OpenBao: fetched at release admission, delivered into release-Job memory over exec, never stored in etcd or on disk.

address.description: OpenBao API base URL. Defaults to the standard in-cluster OpenBao Helm chart service; override if OpenBao is in a different namespace or external. HTTPS required unless insecureHTTPForDev.

k8sAuthMount.description: Kubernetes auth mount path configured in OpenBao.

role.description: OpenBao Kubernetes auth role bound to the chart ServiceAccount.

caCert.description: Optional PEM bundle pinning the OpenBao TLS trust anchors (public material, delivered via ConfigMap).

insecureHTTPForDev.description: DEVELOPMENT ONLY: allow a plain-HTTP OpenBao address.

transit.description: OpenBao Transit engine used for trusted-plan artifact envelopes. Enabled only over verified HTTPS.

kvMount.description: KV v2 mount backing the virtual oberth/upstream/ namespace: a declared oberth/upstream/<rest> path is fetched from '<kvMount>/data/upstream/<rest>'. Must match the mount setup-secretstore.sh enabled (its --kv-prefix).

allowedPaths.description: Administrator allowlist of system-namespace KV API paths repositories may declare through release SecretStoreSecrets. Org/repo-scoped release oberth/upstream/ paths are authorized structurally at admission and are never listed here. Trusted Plan/Apply paths use mandatory repository/phase namespaces and never consult this allowlist; entries addressing the upstream subtree are rejected.

createAuthDelegatorBinding.description: Create the system:auth-delegator ClusterRoleBinding for TokenReview-based logins.
